# XTO Pizza

> XTO Pizza is a pure vegetarian pizza, burger, pasta and shake cafe in Pune, India, with outlets in Nanded City (Sinhagad Road) and Shivane (near NDA, Khadakwasla). Dine-in, takeaway and online delivery within 5 km.

Key facts: pure veg only. Margherita pizza from Rs 99, burgers from Rs 59, combos from Rs 159. Online delivery currently runs from the Nanded City outlet within 5 km, minimum order Rs 199, free on orders of Rs 250 or more including GST, Rs 50 below that. Nanded City open 11:00 am to 11:00 pm, Shivane 11:00 am to 10:30 pm.
